sources.entry: gvwilson/querynomicon: an Introduction to SQL for the Cautious and Weary

summary.one_liner: An introductory SQL tutorial book, "The Querynomicon," aimed at cautious and weary learners, covering SQL basics through Python, R, and PostgreSQL.
summary.what_it_does: The README is a table of contents for a tutorial titled "An Introduction to SQL for the Cautious and Weary." It lists eight lessons: an introduction, core features for getting values from tables, miscellaneous tools, using databases from Python, advanced features, using databases from R, PostgreSQL client-server computing and permissions, and a conclusion. It also lists appendices (license, code of conduct, contributing, bibliography, glossary). Setup asks readers to download the example databases and DB Browser for SQLite. The README itself contains little prose beyond the outline and acknowledgments, so the actual lesson content is not visible here.
use_cases: practicing SQL queries on sample databases
how_to_run: Download the databases used in the examples (per README setup)
Download DB Browser for SQLite (per README setup)
notable: Organized as a lesson sequence progressing from core SQL to Python, R, and PostgreSQL usage
Written for cautious and weary beginners
Acknowledges sqlparse and The Art of PostgreSQL as influences
caveats: README is an outline only; lesson content is not included in the README text
Setup relies on separately downloaded example databases and DB Browser for SQLite
